ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ ۝١
ayahs.translation: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen[1748]

footnotes.1748: In the Hereafter. Disbelievers had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) by invoking Allāh to bring on His punishment. See 8:32.

ayahs.translationClear: A questioner questioned the imminent torment.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ ۝٢
ayahs.translation: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.translationClear: For the disbelievers; none can repel it.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ ۝٣
ayahs.translation: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.
ayahs.translationClear: From Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: تَعْرُجُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ وَالرُّوْحُ اِلَيْهِ فِيْ يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗ خَمْسِيْنَ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
ayahs.transliteration: Ta'rujul-malaa'ikatu war-roohu ilayhi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo khamseena alfa sanah
ayahs.translationClear: Unto Him the angels and the Spirit ascend on a Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا ۝٥
ayahs.translation: So be patient with gracious patience.
ayahs.translationClear: So be patient, with sweet patience.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًا ۝٦
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
ayahs.translationClear: They see it distant.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًا ۝٧
ayahs.translation: But We see it [as] near.
ayahs.translationClear: But We see it near.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ ۝٨
ayahs.translation: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,[1749]
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ۝٩
ayahs.translation: And the mountains will be like wool,[1750]

footnotes.1750: i.e., in the process of disintegration.

ayahs.translationClear: And the mountains will be like tufted wool.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا ۝١٠
ayahs.translation: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
ayahs.translationClear: No friend will care about his friend.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ‌ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: يُّبَصَّرُوْنَهُمْؕ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِيْ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِىِٕذٍۢ بِبَنِيْهِ ۙ

words.translation: They will be made to see each other

ayahs.translation: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
ayahs.transliteration: Yubassaroonahum yawaddul-mujrimu law yaftadee min 'adhaabi yawmi'idhim bibaneeh
ayahs.translationClear: They will be shown each other. The criminal wishes he would be redeemed from the punishment of that Day by his children.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ ۝١٢
ayahs.translation: And his wife and his brother
ayahs.translationClear: And his spouse, and his brother.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ ۝١٣
ayahs.translation: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
ayahs.translationClear: And his family that sheltered him.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنْ فِي الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًاۙ ثُمَّ يُنْجِيْهِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
ayahs.translationClear: And everyone on earth, in order to save him.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّآ‌ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ ۝١٥
ayahs.translation: No![1751] Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

footnotes.1751: An emphatic refusal meaning "It is not to be."

ayahs.translationClear: By no means! It is a Raging Fire.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ ۝١٦

words.translation: of the skin of the head

ayahs.translation: A remover of exteriors.[1752]

footnotes.1752: This refers to the skin of the head or of the body or to the body extremities - which will be burned away.

ayahs.translationClear: It strips away the scalps.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ۝١٧
ayahs.translation: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
ayahs.translationClear: It invites him who once turned his back and fled.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ ۝١٨
ayahs.translation: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
ayahs.translationClear: And accumulated and hoarded.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا ۝١٩
ayahs.translation: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
ayahs.translationClear: Man was created restless.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا ۝٢٠
ayahs.translation: When evil touches him, impatient,
ayahs.translationClear: Touched by adversity, he is fretful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا ۝٢١
ayahs.translation: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
ayahs.translationClear: Touched by good, he is ungenerous.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.translation: Except the observers of prayer -
ayahs.translationClear: Except the prayerful.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.translation: Those who are constant in their prayer
ayahs.translationClear: Those who are constant at their prayers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ ۝٢٤
ayahs.translation: And those within whose wealth is a known right[1753]

footnotes.1753: i.e., a specified share, meaning the obligatory zakāh.

ayahs.translationClear: And those in whose wealth is a rightful share.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ ۝٢٥
ayahs.translation: For the petitioner and the deprived -
ayahs.translationClear: For the beggar and the deprived.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٢٦
ayahs.translation: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translationClear: And those who affirm the Day of Judgment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّشْفِقُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
ayahs.translationClear: And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ ۝٢٨
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
ayahs.translationClear: Their Lord’s punishment is not to be taken for granted.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.translation: And those who guard their private parts
ayahs.translationClear: And those who guard their chastity.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا عَلٰٓي اَزْوَاجِهِمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُوْمِيْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,[1754] for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa 'alaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fa'innahum ghayru maloomeen
ayahs.translationClear: Except from their spouses or those living under their control, for then they are free of blame.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَنِ ابْتَغٰي وَرَا࢜ءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ هُمُ الْعٰدُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
ayahs.translationClear: But whoever seeks to go beyond that—these are the transgressors.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.translation: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
ayahs.translationClear: And those who honor their trusts and their pledges.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.translation: And those who are in their testimonies upright
ayahs.translationClear: And those who stand by their testimonies.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.translation: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
ayahs.translationClear: And those who are dedicated to their prayers.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.translation: They will be in gardens,[1755] honored.
ayahs.translationClear: These will be honored in Gardens.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.translation: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],
ayahs.translationClear: What is with those who disbelieve, stretching their necks towards you.

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.translation: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?[1756]

footnotes.1756: They sat at a distance in order to oppose and mock the Prophet (ﷺ), claiming that they would enter Paradise before the believers.

ayahs.translationClear: From the right, and from the left, banding together?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ امْرِي͏ٔ͏ٍ مِّنْهُمْ اَنْ يُّدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيْمٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
ayahs.transliteration: Ayatma'u kullumri'im minhum an yudkhala jannata na'eem
ayahs.translationClear: Is every one of them aspiring to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?

ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَلَّآ‌ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.translation: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.[1757]

footnotes.1757: i.e., a liquid disdained. So how can they expect to enter Paradise except by the will of their Creator?

ayahs.translationClear: No indeed! We created them from what they know.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا͏ٓ اُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ الْمَشٰرِقِ وَالْمَغٰرِبِ اِنَّا لَقٰدِرُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings[1758] that indeed We are able
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa uqsimu birabbil-mashaariqi wal-maghaaribi innaa laqaadiroon

footnotes.1758: i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā), who determines the point at which the sun, moon and stars rise and set according to season and every position of observation.

ayahs.translationClear: I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, that We are Able.

ayahs.textUthmani: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: عَلٰٓي اَنْ نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْۙ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوْقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
ayahs.transliteration: 'alaa an nubaddila khayram minhum wamaa nahnu bimasbooqeen
ayahs.translationClear: To replace them with better than they, and We are not to be outdone.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوْضُوْا وَيَلْعَبُوْا حَتّٰي يُلٰقُوْا يَوْمَهُمُ الَّذِيْ يُوْعَدُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
ayahs.transliteration: Fadharhum yakhoodoo wayal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee yoo'adoon
ayahs.translationClear: So leave them to blunder and play, until they meet their Day which they are promised.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُوْنَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَاَنَّهُمْ اِلٰي نُصُبٍ يُّوْفِضُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.[1759]
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma yakhrujoona minal-ajdaathi siraa'an ka'annahum ilaa nusubin yoofidoon

footnotes.1759: i.e., just as they used to race, whenever an idol was newly appointed, to be the first of its worshippers.

ayahs.translationClear: The Day when they will emerge from the tombs in a rush, as though they were hurrying towards a target.

ayahs.textUthmani: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: خَاشِعَةً اَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌؕ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِيْ كَانُوْا يُوْعَدُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
ayahs.transliteration: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhaalikal-yawmul-ladhee kaanoo yoo'adoon
ayahs.translationClear: Their eyes cast down; overwhelmed by humiliation. This is the Day which they were promised.
